stories.title: Auto PLI payouts nearly double in FY27
stories.summary: Incentive disbursements under the Production Linked Incentive scheme for the auto industry reached Rs 4,385.28 crore so far in 2026-27. This figure is nearly double the total amount disbursed in all previous financial years combined, according to the Ministry of Heavy Industries. Payouts are accelerating.

stories.title: Auto PLI scheme reaches Rs 6,771 crore in total payouts
stories.summary: The Production Linked Incentive scheme for the auto industry has disbursed Rs 4,385.28 crore in the 2026-27 financial year as of November 25. This brings cumulative disbursements since the scheme's launch to Rs 6,771.64 crore. The program has an approved budgetary outlay of Rs 25,938 crore.

stories.title: Auto PLI scheme disbursements surpass Rs 6,700 crore
stories.summary: Cumulative disbursements under the auto production-linked incentive scheme have reached Rs 6,771.64 crore. The Ministry of Heavy Industries reported that Rs 4,385.28 crore was paid out in the first eight months of the 2026-27 financial year, more than double the total amount disbursed during the entire 2025-26 period.

stories.title: Auto PLI scheme investments exceed government targets
stories.summary: Approved applicants under the auto production-linked incentive scheme reported cumulative investments of Rs 52,806 crore as of September 30, 2026. This figure surpasses the government's target of Rs 42,500 crore. The scheme has also facilitated incremental sales of Rs 82,993 crore and generated 77,755 employment opportunities.

stories.title: India projected to miss 2030 electric vehicle targets
stories.summary: A BloombergNEF report projects India will miss its 2030 electrification targets across all vehicle segments except three-wheelers. Passenger electric vehicle sales are expected to reach 621,000 units by 2030, accounting for 10.2 per cent of the market. Commercial vehicle electrification remains a significant challenge for the nation.

stories.title: Top 10 Best-Selling Cars in India in October 2026 - ACKO Drive
New Toyota Fortuner and VW Virtus facelift scheduled for December
stories.summary: Toyota will debut the next-generation Fortuner in South Africa on December 1, 2026, with an Indian launch expected in 2027. Volkswagen is set to launch the updated Virtus facelift on December 11, 2026. The month will also see reveals for the JSW Combat and Honda Alpha.

stories.title: Delhi EV policy sees limited interest in commercial subsidies
stories.summary: Delhi's Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 offers purchase and scrapping incentives for commercial transport, but application numbers remain low. As of November 2026, the government had received no applications for electric auto-rickshaw purchase subsidies and only 37 applications for electric goods carriers. Adoption remains slow ahead of mandatory deadlines.

Mini Cooper SE returns to India
stories.summary: Mini is relaunching the electric Cooper SE in India on November 27, 2026. The hatchback features a 54.2kWh battery and a claimed WLTP range of 402km. A Paul Smith Edition will also be available, offering exclusive design elements for the returning model.

Toyota launches Innova Hycross flex-fuel hybrid
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor has launched the Innova Hycross Flex Hybrid in India at an introductory price of Rs 19.99 lakh. The vehicle uses a 2.0-litre engine capable of running on ethanol blends from E20 to E85. It delivers a claimed fuel efficiency of 22.58 km per litre on E20.

stories.title: Toyota shifts Innova Hycross to flex-fuel only
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor is replacing all existing strong hybrid variants of the Innova Hycross with a new flex-fuel hybrid powertrain. The updated model supports ethanol blends ranging from E20 to E85. The company stated it selected this model for the technology due to its high customer usage.

stories.title: Toyota targets ethanol flexibility with new Hycross
stories.summary: Toyota has introduced a flex-fuel strong-hybrid powertrain in the updated Innova Hycross. The company believes the ability to run on ethanol blends from E20 to E85 will address motorist concerns regarding varying ethanol levels in petrol. It aims to provide customers with greater flexibility when refuelling.

Bajaj Auto to showcase Pulsar brand at India Bike Week 2026 - ET Auto
Triumph launches Street Triple 798 RS
stories.summary: Triumph has launched the 2027 Street Triple 798 RS at Rs 14.39 lakh. The model features a redesigned chassis, upgraded suspension, and a larger engine than the outgoing 765 RS. It also adds wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. The roadster is now lighter than its predecessor.

stories.title: Royal Enfield Signs ₹1,000 Crore MoU to Invest in EV R&D, Manufacturing in Tamil Nadu - ACKO Drive
Royal Enfield signs EV roadmap agreement
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with the Tamil Nadu government to accelerate its electric vehicle roadmap. The agreement covers a seven-year period. Eicher Motors, the parent company of Royal Enfield, currently holds a market capitalization of Rs 2,28,972.71 crore.

5 Upcoming Made-in-India Motorcycles Launching in Q1 2027 - BikeAdvice
Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 debut expected
stories.summary: Royal Enfield unveiled the Himalayan 750 at EICMA 2026. The motorcycle will serve as the brand's new flagship adventure bike, sitting above the existing 450 model. Pricing and booking details are expected to be announced at Motoverse 2026 in Goa, which runs from November 27 to 29.

stories.title: TVS Jupiter production hits 1 crore units
stories.summary: TVS has manufactured 1 crore units of its Jupiter 110 and 125 scooters combined. First launched in 2013, the Jupiter line is the brand's family-oriented scooter series. TVS claims the milestone makes it the youngest and fastest Indian scooter brand to reach the 1 crore production mark.

stories.title: Porsche 718 Boxster EV nears production
stories.summary: Porsche is entering the final stages of development for its first all-electric 718 Boxster, following a four-million-kilometre testing programme. The 983-generation roadster is scheduled for a world premiere in the first quarter of 2027. The company says it has developed a dedicated architecture to preserve mid-engine characteristics.

stories.title: Suzuki unveils Ignis electric city car
stories.summary: Suzuki has unveiled the Ignis, its first compact electric vehicle for global markets, with sales starting in summer 2027. Developed under the concept of being the best city car for your neighbourhood, the vehicle aims to offer everyday usability. It is intended to appeal to drivers switching to electric.

stories.title: Delhi EV policy sees uneven incentive uptake
stories.summary: Delhi government data shows 12,584 applications for electric two-wheeler subsidies, while zero applications were received for incentives to scrap conventional three-wheelers. Only one application was filed to scrap goods carriers. The figures highlight the difficulty of transitioning different vehicle segments to electric power.

stories.title: Electric Car Sales in India in First Seven Months of FY2027 Cross FY2026 Total: JMK Research - ACKO Drive
Department of Energy eyes 100,000 EV registrations
stories.summary: The Department of Energy expects the number of registered electric vehicles to exceed 100,000 by the end of 2026. The projection was shared via ANC 24/7.

stories.title: IIT Madras to host electric trucking dialogue
stories.summary: IIT Madras will host the eCV Dialogue on January 21 and 22, 2027, to address the slow adoption of electric commercial vehicles. The conclave aims to identify actionable steps for the freight sector, as medium and heavy-duty vehicles account for nearly 25 per cent of India's oil import bill.

stories.title: New EV charging sites in North Northamptonshire
stories.summary: North Northamptonshire Council and Connected Kerb have installed new electric vehicle charging sockets across 20 sites in the county. The project is intended to serve approximately 3,228 homes that lack access to off-street parking. Locations include Barton Seagrave, Corby, Finedon, Higham Ferrers, and Irchester.

stories.title: IIT Madras schedules freight transport dialogue
stories.summary: IIT Madras is holding the eCV Dialogue on January 21-22 to address the gap in India's electric freight transport transition. The event will bring together policymakers and industrial leaders to focus on actionable policies. Medium and heavy-duty vehicles contribute nearly 25% of India's oil import bill.

stories.title: Electric Porsche Boxster enters final development, ahead of 2027 launch
stories.summary: Porsche is gearing up to debut its first fully-electric two-door sports car, with the 718 Boxster EV now undergoing final development and testing ahead of its production reveal in early 2027. Ahead of that, Porsche has revealed new photos of the EV undergoing testing, along with more details of what

stories.title: Humble Robotics targets short-haul freight
stories.summary: Humble Robotics has raised $51 million to develop the Humble Hauler, a cabless electric truck for short, repetitive routes. The startup claims removing the driver's cab makes the vehicle 20% lighter than a conventional tractor-trailer. Total funding for the project has reached $75 million.

stories.title: Online commercial vehicle insurance adoption jumps 46%
stories.summary: Online adoption of commercial vehicle insurance in India rose 46 percent year-on-year, according to Policybazaar. Non-heavy commercial vehicles accounted for 91 percent of this growth. While 75 percent of buyers opted for comprehensive policies, 25 percent chose third-party cover. The market is moving toward more coverage.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland and Force Motors report Q2 results
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland revenue rose 35.1 percent to Rs 17,174 crore with an 8.8 percent profit increase. Force Motors revenue rose 40.9 percent to Rs 2,967 crore, though profit fell. The two companies represent different segments of the Indian commercial vehicle market, from heavy trucks to specialized vans.

stories.title: Union Cabinet approves Rs 11,000 crore equipment manufacturing scheme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved an 8-year scheme to boost domestic manufacturing of construction and infrastructure equipment. The plan offers sales-linked incentives of 8 percent to 13 percent on incremental sales from FY29 to FY33. The government aims to encourage local production of advanced machinery and critical components.

stories.title: Cabinet clears Rs 20,000 crore infrastructure and equipment package
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved projects worth nearly Rs 20,000 crore, including an Rs 11,000 crore scheme to substitute imports of construction equipment parts. Other projects include a new airport in Silchar and a second container terminal at Kamarajar Port. The equipment scheme was first announced in the budget.

stories.title: Government targets construction equipment imports with Rs 11,000 crore plan
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved an Rs 11,000 crore scheme to boost domestic manufacturing of construction and infrastructure equipment. The 8-year program aims to strengthen the local ecosystem and reduce reliance on imports. Concerns regarding dependence on China for critical machinery were cited as a driver for the policy.

stories.title: Linamar to acquire Genie for $1.4 billion
stories.summary: Linamar plans to acquire Genie from Terex for approximately $1.4 billion. The company expects the deal to add $3.3 billion in trailing 12-month sales and generate $135 million in annual run-rate synergies by the third year. The acquisition is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Automotive aluminium extrusion market projected to reach $15 billion
stories.summary: The automotive aluminium extrusion market is expected to grow at a 7.3 percent CAGR to reach $15 billion by 2030, according to a report by The Business Research Company. Growth is attributed to the industry shift toward lightweight vehicle components and evolving automotive technologies.

stories.title: Auto parts manufacturing market forecast at $1.1 trillion by 2030
stories.summary: The global auto parts manufacturing market is projected to reach $1,128.31 billion by 2030, growing at a 9.1 percent CAGR, according to The Business Research Company. The sector expansion is driven by technological advancements and shifts in vehicle production methods across the global automotive industry.

stories.title: Hyundai Mobis secures $745 million in parts orders
stories.summary: Hyundai Mobis has won $745 million in parts orders and expects full-year overseas contracts to exceed targets. The company has also been selected to supply components for 10,000 units of Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot. The robot's supply chain is now reportedly led by Hyundai-affiliated firms.

stories.title: Matangi Rubber Limited announces Rs 125.16 crore IPO
stories.summary: Matangi Rubber Limited has announced an IPO of Rs 125.16 crore, with shares priced between Rs 163 and Rs 172. The issue opens on December 1, 2026. The company intends to use the funds to expand its operations into solid tyre manufacturing and rubber recycling.

stories.title: Japanese automakers target common standards for materials
stories.summary: Japanese automakers and parts suppliers are working to standardize steel, recycled plastics and wiring harness specifications. The Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association says the effort aims to reduce costs and strengthen supply chains. The industry is currently facing a shrinking workforce and a weak yen.

stories.title: China automotive aluminium sheet production declines
stories.summary: China's automotive aluminium sheet production is expected to reach 495,000 metric tonnes in 2026, a 2.2 percent decline from 2025. This marks the first negative turn for the market following a period of rapid expansion between 2021 and 2025, during which the sector saw a 12.2 percent CAGR.

stories.title: Visteon expands Indian manufacturing with new production line
stories.summary: Visteon Corporation has launched a new production line for Cellular Network Access Device modules at its Chennai plant. The modules support telematics solutions for both Indian and global markets. The investment is intended to expand the company's local manufacturing capabilities within the region.

stories.title: Swansway BYD offers used electric vehicles in Stoke-on-Trent
stories.summary: Swansway BYD is offering a selection of used and nearly-new electric and hybrid models at its Stoke-on-Trent dealership. The dealership aims to provide an alternative route into electric vehicle ownership for motorists looking to avoid the price of a brand-new model.

stories.title: Cox Automotive forecasts 15.8 million unit sales for November
stories.summary: Cox Automotive forecasts November sales at 15.8 million units on a seasonally adjusted annual rate. Meanwhile, Amazon Autos has expanded its platform to 35 brands. The industry continues to emphasize the role of reliable transportation as a factor in upward economic mobility for households.

stories.title: Amazon Autos to launch in the UK in 2027
stories.summary: Amazon is expanding its online car-buying platform to the United Kingdom in early 2027. Hyundai will be the first brand available on the site, with plans to add more partners before the service goes live. The platform currently operates in the United States.

Premium car sales accelerate as Poles buy more luxury
stories.summary: Luxury car sales in Poland surged by over 32% year on year, according to a KPMG report. The study suggests that Poles are becoming more affluent and that luxury products are increasingly accessible. Clothing and accessories remain the most popular luxury goods, followed by hotels and spa services.

stories.title: Queretaro auto sales rise 6.5% in October
stories.summary: New vehicle sales in Queretaro reached 3,286 units in October, a 6.5% increase year over year. Despite the growth, cumulative sales from January through October remain 1.6% below 2025 levels. The market has now posted two consecutive months of year-over-year growth following a 2.9% rise in September.

stories.title: Querétaro new vehicle sales rise 6.5%
stories.summary: New vehicle sales in Querétaro rose 6.5% year over year in October, with 3,286 units sold. The performance marks two consecutive months of growth for the state. However, cumulative sales from January through October remain 1.6% lower than the same period in 2025, with 29,274 vehicles sold.

Polestar Q3 revenue falls 14% as losses continue
stories.summary: Polestar reported a $403 million net loss for the third quarter, with revenue falling 14% to $642 million. Retail sales rose 1% to 14,371 vehicles, while gross margin was negative 18.1%. Cash reserves dropped to $653 million, down from $1.159 billion at the end of 2025.

Li Auto reports third consecutive quarterly loss
stories.summary: Li Auto reported a net loss of 309.7 million yuan for the third quarter of 2026, marking its third straight quarterly loss. Revenue rose 5.4% to 28.8 billion yuan, and free cash flow turned positive. The loss narrowed from 624.4 million yuan reported a year earlier.

stories.title: iA Dealer Services appoints Vachon to executive role
stories.summary: iA Dealer Services has appointed Benoît Vachon as Vice-President of Strategy, Product, Marketing and Strategic Projects. The company stated the move is intended to strengthen its market position and advance strategic priorities. Vachon previously led risk management and compliance efforts for the organization.

India auto insurance market sees 2026 updates
stories.summary: India's motor insurance market continues to offer various options for vehicle owners, including cashless claim processing. A new four-layer framework is set to begin on December 15, 2026. Third-party premiums start at 2,094 rupees per year, with a maximum no-claim bonus of 50% available to consumers.

stories.title: PNB and Deutsche Bank partner for acquisition financing
stories.summary: Punjab National Bank and Deutsche Bank have signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on acquisition financing for Indian clients. The partnership aims to provide tailored solutions for equity deals, including underwriting and syndication. The banks intend to leverage their respective strengths to expand corporate banking services.

stories.title: VinFast focuses on software-defined vehicle technology
stories.summary: VinFast is investing in proprietary software, driver-assistance systems and AI-powered driving to compete in the automotive industry. The company says competitive advantage is now defined by computing power and software architecture. These technologies determine how vehicles perceive their surroundings and anticipate hazards on the road.

stories.title: Automakers look to add sound to electric vehicles
stories.summary: Lexus is working to redefine the sound of electric sports cars following a decree from Toyota chairman Akio Toyoda to make no more boring cars. Automakers are increasingly using custom sounds to give electric vehicles a distinct identity, ranging from engine-like growls to quieter cabin experiences.

stories.title: Geely receives sustainability recognition
stories.summary: Geely Automobile Holdings was included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook for the first time in 2026. The company ranked fifth in its category in the Corporate Sustainability Assessment and received an Industry Mover award. Geely is the only Chinese car manufacturer to be recognized this year.

stories.title: AUTOCRYPT to showcase security at CES 2027
stories.summary: AUTOCRYPT announced it will present security solutions for the Physical AI ecosystem at CES 2027 in Las Vegas. The company plans to leverage its automotive cybersecurity portfolio to address needs in robotics, defense and industrial machinery. It is also expanding into software-defined vehicle platforms.

stories.title: BlackBerry positions QNX for physical AI and robotics
stories.summary: BlackBerry is positioning its QNX business at the intersection of AI, robotics and automotive software. The company plans to showcase new demonstrations at CES 2027, highlighting how its safety-certified, real-time software supports complex intelligent systems. The firm is currently pivoting its focus toward these emerging industrial automation markets.

stories.title: VinFast builds software strategy for intelligent vehicles
stories.summary: Vietnamese automaker VinFast is investing in proprietary software, driver-assistance systems and AI-powered automated driving. The company aims to compete in a software-defined automotive industry where competitive advantage is increasingly determined by computing power and vehicle architecture. The race now extends well beyond batteries and electric motors.

stories.title: Infineon expands radar portfolio for centralized vehicle architectures
stories.summary: Infineon Technologies has introduced the CTRX8144FS, a 76-81 GHz radar sensor with four transmit and four receive channels. The device is designed for centralized vehicle architectures and advanced driver assistance systems. It supports applications like cross-traffic monitoring and lane merging as manufacturers move away from distributed sensor designs.

stories.title: BlackBerry targets QNX growth as royalty backlog climbs
stories.summary: BlackBerry executives stated the company is focusing on QNX and secure communications to sustain growth. The firm expects to generate 150 million dollars in EBITDA this year following the divestment of its Cylance endpoint security business. Software content in vehicles remains a primary driver for the company's financial profile.

stories.title: Twenty electric vehicle versions lose eco-score eligibility
stories.summary: New methods for calculating environmental scores have resulted in twenty versions of electric cars losing their eco-certification. The list includes models from Ford, Hyundai, Renault and Mazda. These changes, finalized in late November, affect the status of vehicles already in use or currently under order.

stories.title: Swinney rejects presumption for low-carbon public sector fleet
stories.summary: First Minister John Swinney has rejected calls to mandate that all public sector vehicles be low-carbon. Edinburgh MSP Sanne Dijkstra-Downie noted that over 80 percent of local authority vehicles still run on petrol or diesel. The government expects councils to make these transition decisions themselves.

stories.title: US proposes 20 percent tariffs on major trading partners
stories.summary: The Trump administration has proposed new tariffs of up to 20 percent on China, the European Union and 12 other nations. The duties follow an investigation into excess manufacturing capacity. If implemented, the rates could result in total tariffs exceeding 40 percent on certain Chinese goods.

stories.title: Government to respond to ZEV mandate consultation by year end
stories.summary: Business secretary Jonathan Reynolds confirmed the government will publish its response to electric car sales targets by the end of the year. Ministers are reportedly considering reducing the 2030 mandate from 80 percent to 60 percent, citing the need for a manageable transition pace for automotive manufacturers.

stories.title: SMMT warns EV targets threaten UK automotive investment
stories.summary: The SMMT warns that Britain risks losing investment unless ministers reform EV sales targets and protect trade. Carmakers spent over 10 billion pounds on EV discounts in 2024 and 2025 to stimulate demand. The trade body expects zero-emission cars to reach 37.5 percent of the market in 2028.

stories.title: EU hybrid quotas could curb UK auto exports, industry group says - Automotive News
US proposes two-year extension for mandatory automatic emergency braking systems - ET Auto
SMMT seeks ZEV mandate reform and tariff-free EU trade
stories.summary: The SMMT has called on the UK government to revise its zero-emission vehicle mandate and maintain tariff-free trade with the EU. The trade body claims that high production costs and potential trade barriers are deterring investment in UK vehicle manufacturing and the broader automotive supply chain.

stories.title: Manufacturers report 10 billion pound cost for EV targets
stories.summary: The SMMT says carmakers cannot sustain the cost of meeting EV targets after spending 10 billion pounds on discounts during 2024 and 2025. The trade body argues that fundamental reform is required to prevent the loss of future automotive investment in the United Kingdom.

Haridwar T20 League holds draft and jersey launch
stories.summary: The Haridwar T20 League held its player draft, trophy reveal and jersey launch on Monday. The event included representatives from all six franchises and officials from the Cricket Association of Uttarakhand. The tournament is organised by the Cricket Association of Haridwar and marks a milestone for the league.

stories.title: NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series event scheduled for April
stories.summary: The 2027 NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series is scheduled to take place at Martinsville Speedway on April 17. The event will be broadcast on The CW. Further details regarding the leaderboard and betting odds remain pending as the race date approaches.

stories.title: NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series race set for Darlington
stories.summary: The 2027 NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series is scheduled to visit Darlington Raceway on April 3. The race will be broadcast on The CW. Additional information regarding the event leaderboard and odds will be made available closer to the start of the competition.

stories.title: Jeet Jhabakh highlights financial barriers in Indian motorsport
stories.summary: Rally driver Jeet Jhabakh recently became the first Indian to win the FIA Asia-Pacific Rally Championship overall title. He noted that motorsport remains a rich man's sport, citing the struggle for financial backing and international exposure. He hopes his victory will open doors for other talented Indian racers.

stories.title: Kolkata Royal Tigers look to build on recent gains as racing festival returns to BIC
stories.summary: The Kolkata Royal Tigers franchise is preparing for the Indian Racing League and F4 Indian Championship at the Buddh International Circuit. Team owner Sourav Ganguly cited recent podium finishes and a maiden victory as evidence of the team's potential. The drivers are now expected to maintain that momentum.

stories.title: MotoGP Valencia 2026: Practice, qualifying, sprint, race times and how to watch
stories.summary: The 2026 MotoGP season concludes at the Circuit Ricardo Tormo this weekend. Marc Márquez has already secured the world championship, but the Constructors' Championship and other standings remain open. The event marks the final appearance for the current 1000cc engine era before new regulations take effect.

stories.title: India eyes Formula One return, task force to examine 2028 Grand Prix feasibility
stories.summary: India has formed a multi-stakeholder task force to evaluate the feasibility of hosting a Formula One Grand Prix in 2028. The panel is tasked with addressing taxation, infrastructure, and investment challenges to revive domestic motorsports. The government is now exploring a structured path toward a potential return.

stories.title: Preparations underway for return of F1 to India: Sports Minister Mandaviya - DD News
Mechanic trains in Aruba for electric vehicle future
stories.summary: Bermuda Motors mechanic Patrick Abuluyan recently completed specialist training in Aruba focused on Toyota battery electric vehicles. The programme covered high-tech diagnostics and noise, vibration, and harshness issues. As vehicles become more sophisticated, the requirements for keeping them on the road are shifting accordingly.

stories.title: The EV industry is getting more from every battery. It should do the same with cars.
stories.summary: Rivian and Redwood Materials have expanded a partnership to manage the full lifecycle of vehicle batteries, including recycling and second-life storage. The initiative aims to capture value from packs that no longer meet the power requirements for driving. Discarding them is now being framed as a sustainability oversight.

stories.title: At 74,000 miles, this BMW i3's battery still exceeds its original usable capacity rating
stories.summary: A 2017 BMW i3 with 74,600 miles on the odometer reportedly shows 27.3 kilowatt-hours of usable battery energy. This figure exceeds the vehicle's original rating despite years of use. The owner shared the diagnostic data in a recent review, suggesting the battery has held up over time.

stories.title: How much range do EVs really lose in cold weather?
stories.summary: A study by Recurrent found that electric vehicles retain an average of 78 percent of their charge at 32 degrees Fahrenheit. While critics often claim EVs lose all charge in cold weather, the data suggests otherwise. Any EV can handle the cold, according to the company's research.

stories.title: Volvo celebrates 50 years of EV innovation: Elbil to EX60
stories.summary: Volvo is marking 50 years of electric development by comparing its 1976 Elbil prototype to the modern EX60 SUV. The original four-seater offered a 31-mile range, while the new model promises up to 503 miles. The company maintains there is a through line between the two vehicles.

stories.title: Volvo celebrates 50 years of electric cars
stories.summary: Volvo has marked half a century of electric motoring, commemorating the 1976 launch of its Elbil prototype. The original vehicle featured a 4.3kWh lead acid battery and a 31-mile range. The company claims this basic city car established a foundation for its current range of premium electric SUVs.

stories.title: renative®: giving the circular economy greater visibility in Renault vehicles
stories.summary: Renault is launching its renative® umbrella brand to highlight the use of recycled materials in its vehicles. The Scenic E-Tech electric will be the first to feature the branding on its seats, which are made from 98 percent recycled textile. The move aims to reduce reliance on primary resources.

stories.title: Renault brings renative recycled label to new vehicles - Automotive World
Kia, Lucid, and Volkswagen are slashing EV prices by $10,000+ for Black Friday
stories.summary: Several automakers are offering discounts of $10,000 or more on select electric vehicles for Black Friday. US EV sales reached their highest point since late 2025 during the third quarter. With new models arriving, manufacturers are attempting to maintain momentum in a market that had previously slowed.

stories.title: Auto sector in Canada is moving away from U.S. imports: DesRosiers
stories.summary: Data from DesRosiers Automotive Consultants indicates that Canadian light vehicle imports from the United States fell to 40 percent of the total in 2026, down from 49.1 percent in 2024. Imports from Mexico and Japan have increased during the same period amid ongoing trade tensions.

stories.title: Xiaomi plans launch of EVs in Europe
stories.summary: Xiaomi intends to begin selling electric vehicles in Europe, with Germany targeted for the third quarter of 2027. The company is currently recruiting dealers and testing vehicles for right-hand-drive markets. A spokesperson declined to comment on whether the United Kingdom would follow the initial German launch.

stories.title: Canadian auto sector moving away from U.S. imports amid trade war: DesRosiers
stories.summary: A report from DesRosiers Automotive Consultants shows that US-sourced light vehicle imports into Canada dropped to 40 percent of the total in 2026. This is a decline from 49.1 percent in 2024. Meanwhile, imports from Mexico and Japan have grown as the sector pivots to other global markets.

stories.title: Xiaomi Auto seeks UK dealer network chief as it prepares to sell EVs in Britain
stories.summary: Xiaomi is hiring a UK head of network development to establish a sales network for its electric cars. The company is targeting a mid-2027 launch for the British market. While the company has confirmed recruitment in right-hand-drive regions, it has not yet officially named the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Why China’s electric cars are parking back and forth
stories.summary: Videos circulating on social media show electric vehicles in China repeatedly driving out of and back into parking spaces. While some observers initially suspected a system malfunction, the behavior appears to be a form of competitive parking. The cars perform the maneuvers with high levels of synchronization.

stories.title: U.S. electric car sales fall for the second consecutive quarter
stories.summary: Americans bought 216,000 new electric cars in the first three months of 2026, according to Cox Automotive. Sales fell 27 percent year-over-year, following a 36 percent drop in the previous quarter. The market is currently undergoing a period of adjustment to its previous growth trajectory.

stories.title: Spain electric vehicle sales
BYD enters talks to acquire Ineos plant in France
stories.summary: BYD has begun exclusive negotiations to acquire the Ineos assembly plant in Hambach. The company aims to strengthen local production amid tightening EU import restrictions. The manufacturer is looking to secure a second European facility to bypass the continent's new trade barriers.

Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Beyond the Benchmark: Localizing Released Autonomous Driving Models to Real Vehicles
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Released autonomous-driving models achieve strong benchmark performance, yet deploying them on a new real vehicle remains challenging. We study this deployment gap and find that released models can remain coupled to assumptions from their source sensing. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Compositional Reachset-Conformant Modeling for Managing Uncertainty in the Development of Cyber-Physical Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The development of cyber-physical systems (CPS) proceeds through iterative design revisions, and compliance with safety requirements must be re-established after every revision, typically based on a system model. Conventional models, however, predict only the most likely. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: DAA for an Autonomous Delivery Drone: Maneuver Selection Policies for Near-Collision Risk Avoidance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Detect-and-avoid (DAA) systems for autonomous drones operating in shared airspace must select avoidance maneuvers under conditions that differ markedly from those assumed by conventional DAA architectures designed for crewed aircraft. Limited on-board sensing capabilities restrict detection. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Exteroceptive Sensor Faults in Autonomous Vehicles: A Cross-Modal Taxonomy and Fault Injection Toolkit
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous vehicles rely on cameras, LiDAR, and radar to perceive their surroundings, yet these exteroceptive sensors can be degraded by hardware aging, environmental interference, miscalibration, embedded software errors, and combinations of these causes, with direct consequences. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: From Safety-Driven Redundancy to Value-Driven Architecture: An ODD-Based Rationalization Framework for Level 4 Autonomous Vehicles
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Level 4 autonomous vehicles require fault-tolerant architectures that preserve critical driving functions under sensing, computing, communication, power, and actuation failures. As these systems progress toward industrial scalability, architectural complexity, validation burden, integration effort, and lifecycle cost. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Gaussian Process Data-Driven Hamiltonian for Probabilistic Safe Set Construction
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability is a general framework for verifying the safety of nonlinear systems, but it relies on an accurate dynamics model. The data-driven Hamiltonian (DDH) framework avoids system identification by lower-bounding the Hamiltonian directly from. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
